## Install

1. Download **Compass-…-win-x64.zip** below.
2. Right-click it › **Extract All**. (Don't run it from inside the zip.)
3. Open the extracted folder and double-click **Compass.exe**, then click **Install**.

It installs just for you, without admin rights, and adds Start menu and Desktop shortcuts. On first launch a short setup asks a few questions and builds Compass around your answers.

**Updating:** already have Compass 0.4.0 or later? It updates itself: look for the **Update** button in the title bar. On older versions, install this one the same way; it keeps all your data.
**Uninstalling:** Settings › Apps › Installed apps › Compass › Uninstall.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit. Your data stays on your PC.
